initialization_requirements: Measured solid fraction or a documented conversion from void ratio.
Elastic volumetric and signed shear strains on the admissible positive branch, consistent with elastic stress and the chosen parameters.
Mesoscopic temperature or a justified zero-temperature history; this is not ordinary measured temperature.
Initial physical time and prescribed strain rate; nonzero-temperature total stress includes instantaneous rate-dependent contributions.
Recompute a consistent initial state after changing material parameters; the source preset elastic strains do not preserve pressure automatically.
calibration_information_to_investigate: Nonlinear elastic and density response at stated rates.
Compression-state and critical-state evidence for the selected Figure 1 variant.
Multiple physical loading rates and durations, creep/relaxation or rate changes to distinguish transient mechanisms.
Joint normalization convention and initial mesoscopic state; do not count a scaling gauge as an extra independently identifiable coefficient.
limitations_and_review_questions: Clay research draft cannot enter the current sand panel or rate-independent adapter.
Fixed-axis stress invariants do not establish general 3D, rotational or finite-strain applicability.
Physical time, durations, rate jumps and state/output continuity require explicit handling.
Author RHS comparisons, independent equation review, original numerical-procedure reproduction and experimental validation are distinct gates.
Figure 1/Appendix B distinctions, rounded pOne preset and author mixed-control discrepancies remain source-review limits.
Nine material-role entries after fixing normalization are not nine established identifiable material constants.
